title: Non-Uniqueness of Solutions in Neural Variational Methods
summary: Recent work has shown that strong-form physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) based on pointwise enforcement of differential operators can be ill-posed due to the combination of sufficiently expressive neural network trial spaces with finitely many measurements. In this work, we develop an abstract analytical framework that isolates this finite-information mechanism and extends its applicability beyond strong-form formulations.
